def get_status(node):
    """
    Builds a dict of status from a workflow manifest.

    Parameters
    ----------
    node : dict

    Returns
    -------
    str
    """
    # check if pipeline was interrupted
    if "message" in node and str(node["message"]) == "terminated":
        status = "Terminated"
    else:
        status = str(node["phase"])

    return status
